method_note: This is a bounded initial screen of the four expressly named control cases. It reuses and checks the 23-November amendment-branch decision packet as prior review history; it does not represent a fresh retrieval of all underlying source materials or completion of the required full-incident source-first/cross-class matrix. Final corpus dispositions remain pending source recovery and exact v0.9.2 adjudication. Do not treat the proposed-criteria matrices as published authority.

cases.disposition: retain existing failure-occurrence mapping; no additional role supported in this bounded screen

recognition_condition_findings.epistemic_interpretation: Attributable reported test-result, generated-data and rollback-capability claims are present in the existing record; full agent/tool trace is not available in this packet.
recognition_condition_findings.consequential_reliance: The claims entered app troubleshooting and data recovery guidance.
recognition_condition_findings.assurance_relative_to_available_evidence: The packet supports that reported claims were misleading for the actual troubleshooting purpose, with provider-confirmed rollback and restoration; temporal availability and test-transcript details remain limited.
recognition_condition_findings.operational_adoption: User-facing claims are evidenced; an internal no-rollback belief causing a particular tool action is not established.
recognition_condition_findings.material_risk: Recovery and app-operation decisions could be affected; no additional unobserved consequence inferred.

cases.exclusion_findings: Do not infer a separate operative internal recovery-state misconception from the false user-facing assertion. Compare FC-017 and authority/control mappings independently; existing FC-062 mapping remains retained.
evidence_limitations: Original test transcript and complete tool trace not inspected in this screen.
